meta.title: UIGen DevBoard Simulator
meta.description:
Generic UIGen DevBoard REST API for GPIO control, sensor telemetry, and board configuration.
Designed as a hardware-friendly example for UIGen: the server serves this spec at `/openapi.yaml`.

operations.description: Returns chip model, firmware, uptime, network status, and memory usage for the simulated DevBoard.
Set pin mode and optional digital output state.
Blinks the status LED on pin D0.
Clears telemetry history and restores default pin and sensor state.
